story: Something is wrong in the state of QED [pdf]
text: The paper is written in scathing tones, by page 11 I was laughing at each new report of QED's 'perfect' agreement with whatever was the latest experimental result for the electron's anomalous magnetic moment although as it continued as far as page 14, it became sobering. However, the recent discrepancies are way down in the decimal points of the result now; when these calculations require 1000s of complicated Feynman diagrams and pages and pages of calculation, errors seem inevitable. My hope is that an alternative approach can be found that avoids these complicated calculations and in fact, researchers already seem to be working on this [1]. [1] Nima Arkani-Hamed - The End of Spacetime (Sep 2022) [VIDEO]
Umm SpaceTime is likely NOT to be fundamental or continuous [VIDEO] Also Bells Therom implies no locality or non realism which to me furthers the nail on the coffin of spacetime
